enunciado: Implement a recursive gcd(a, b) with Euclid's algorithm (gcd(a, 0) = a; gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, a % b)) and lcm(a, b) = a / gcd(a, b) * b. Show the results for (48, 18), (17, 5) and (100, 75), and simplify the fraction 84/126.
objetivos: Translate a recursive mathematical definition into code
Reuse gcd to solve other problems
pistas: The second argument shrinks on every call.
Divide before multiplying in lcm to avoid overflow.
To simplify a/b divide both by gcd(a, b).
